about: Manufacturer figures shown to users. Each fact carries a verbatim quote from its source document; tools/verify_manufacturer.py checks that every quote and value really appears in that document and that the document is the one fingerprinted here. The documents themselves are copyrighted and are not redistributed: download them from the URLs below into data/sources/ to re-run the check.
